primaryChecks.text: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:
primaryChecks.previousContext: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 5:11 はBashanを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
primaryChecks.previousContext: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:
primaryChecks.nextContext: Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 5:12 はBashanを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon as far as their borders.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.
primaryChecks.nextContext: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 5:16 はBashanを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
primaryChecks.previousContext: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.
primaryChecks.nextContext: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 5:23 はBashanを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
primaryChecks.previousContext: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.
primaryChecks.nextContext: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 6:62 はBashanを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands;
primaryChecks.previousContext: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its pasture lands, and Bileam with its pasture lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.
primaryChecks.nextContext: and out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 6:71 はBashanを地理的な対象として明記する。
